lessons: This repository encodes rung discipline (ADR-0007: a check blocks only once it has been measured to pass) and treats an invented ratchet baseline as a defect, so any Ascent item that asks for a numeric budget or ceiling is unresolvable in a session without a shell — the measurement, not the wiring, is the missing half.

Before reporting a gap here, check whether the repository already answers it under a different name: `.github/constraint-map.json` maps every stated rule to what enforces it and at which rung, and docs/task-index.md routes a task to the document that governs it. Several scan findings (SBOM/signing, broad write grants, unscheduled real-model proves) were already decided and documented against.

`.github/workflows/`, the ADRs and the agent instruction surface are CODEOWNERS law files that AGENTS.md places in the red zone; adding a new gate also means registering it in the constraint map, the contract ledger, the gate-remedy table and the fence census, each held by a unit test — so a 'small' new check is a multi-file change that cannot be validated without running `npm run test:unit`.
